summary: OpenText priced $500M of 6.700% senior secured notes due 2031 and $500M of 7.150% senior secured notes due 2033 via Rule 144A/Reg S, expected to close October 1, 2026. Net proceeds plus cash on hand fund redemption in full of $1.0B 6.900% 2027 notes and consideration for up to $450M principal of 3.875% 2028 notes tendered, subject to increase or decrease. Notes and guarantees are secured on the same basis as existing secured credit facilities and the 2027 notes. Watch tender participation, proration, and any upsizing of the 2028 cap.
